records: PhotonPay's USD65B annualized transaction volume is total platform TPV across fiat and stablecoin rails. Stablecoin-only volume, asset composition, supported chains, XRP share and SBI's investment amount are not disclosed.

SBI/Startale's Open Standard participation and JPYSC-OUSD interoperability are pilot exploration only. No commercial service, production settlement, direct Coinbase bilateral contract or XRP route is established.
SBI/Startale/BlackRock's tokenized-MMF/JPYSC arrangement is an MOU. The specific fund, chain, asset balances, issuance, settlement volumes and implementation timeline remain undisclosed.

JPYSC's approximately JPY20.1B issuance, JPY10B JGB allocation and JPY6.9B lending applications are dated September 7, 2026. The lending figure is applications, not accepted/outstanding loans. JPYSC remains account-only without public-chain external transfers at current capture.
SMBC's 5% stake in SBI Startale Marketing is confirmed, but the investment amount and current operating economics of the JV are not disclosed.
SBI's approximately USD50M Startale investment is historical strategic equity capital; it is not JPYSC reserve capital, XRP purchases or evidence of Ripple/Circle price support.
